en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: it reads like a modern town anthem for Strumica but I cannot name an author. 'Бело злато' I read as cotton or tobacco, my reading; 'ви'ле' = 'видовте/виделе', 'тук'' = 'тука'.

lines.cyr: Макот кај белее, топло сонце грее,
lines.lat: Makot kaj belee, toplo sonce gree,
lines.en: Where the poppy whitens, the warm sun shines,

lines.cyr: рано жито жнее, бостанот што пее,
lines.lat: rano žito žnee, bostanot što pee,
lines.en: early wheat is reaped, the melon field sings,
grapes turn red, white gold ripens,
peanuts ripen, the people of Strumica sing:

lines.cyr: расцутена в' пролет, прекрасна во есен.
lines.lat: rascutena v' prolet, prekrasna vo esen.
lines.en: in bloom in spring, magnificent in autumn.
the early spring when it wakes?

lines.cyr: Росно цвеќе разно сегде се расцути,
lines.lat: Rosno cveḱe razno segde se rascuti,
lines.en: Dewy flowers of all kinds bloom everywhere,

lines.cyr: расцутена в' пролет, прекрасна во есен.
lines.lat: rascutena v' prolet, prekrasna vo esen.
lines.en: in bloom in spring, magnificent in autumn.

lines.cyr: Струмица што има, секаде го нема,
lines.lat: Strumica što ima, sekade go nema,
lines.en: What Strumica has, is nowhere else,

lines.cyr: Излети прават в' Банско и Дојран,
lines.lat: Izleti pravat v' Bansko i Dojran,
lines.en: They make trips to Bansko and Dojran,

lines.cyr: песна тук' се ори, жива и весела:
lines.lat: pesna tuk' se ori, živa i vesela:
lines.en: song resounds here, lively and cheerful:

lines.cyr: расцутена в' пролет, прекрасна во есен.
lines.lat: rascutena v' prolet, prekrasna vo esen.
lines.en: in bloom in spring, magnificent in autumn.
